http/http2_settings#

The SETTINGS this side advertises on an HTTP/2 connection.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Http2Settings();                     // 4096 table, 65535 window, 16384 frames, 100 streams

Description#

The SETTINGS this side advertises on an HTTP/2 connection.

Public API#

object Http2Settings#

object Http2Settings

Local bounded receive advertisements, not received peer settings and not an H2 session. Zero table/window/stream cap is meaningful and permitted.

Http2Settings.Http2Settings#

Http2Settings()

A 4096-byte header table, a 65535-byte window, 16384-byte frames, 100 streams.
